- **Plant part affected:** Stems (culms) of wheat plants, laid out on white paper for display

**Reasoning through classes:**

- The orange-red pustules concentrated on **stems** rule out leaf diseases (Septoria, Tan Spot, Stripe Rust, Powdery Mildew, Bacterial Streak)
- The brick-red/orange coloration and pustule morphology on stems is the hallmark of **stem rust** (Puccinia graminis)
- Stripe Rust produces yellow-orange pustules in stripes on **leaves**, not stems
- Wheat Leaf Rust produces pustules primarily on **leaves**, not stems
- The pustule color and location on the culm is classic **Wheat Stem Rust** (Puccinia graminis f. sp. tritici)
